# CLI reference

Invoke as `agentic-kanban <command>`; inside a checkout of this repo, `pnpm cli -- <command>`.
Run any command with `--help` for its options — this list is names and purpose only.

## Top-level

| Command | Does |
|---|---|
| `cleanup` | Show stale worktrees for closed workspaces, and clean up leaked temp-fixture project registrations |
| `create` | Create a new git repo and register it as a project |
| `delete-status <status-id>` | Delete a project status (fails if issues are linked to it) |
| `dev` | Start the development server (server + built client UI) |
| `export-backlog` | Export a project's full backlog (issues, statuses, tags, milestones, dependencies) as a portable JSON snapshot for moving between devices |
| `import-backlog` | Import a backlog snapshot (from `export-backlog`) into a project |
| `init` | Initialize agentic-kanban for the first time |
| `install-skill` | Install agent skills into a project's .claude/skills/ directory, or into your user agent-skill directories with --user |
| `list` | List all registered projects |
| `register` | Register a git repo as a project |
| `status` | Show board status overview with all active agents, workspaces, and progress |
| `unregister` | Remove a registered project by name or ID |

## backlog

Backlog as ONE markdown file — export with filters, import (standard or liberal markdown) with a dry-run preview.

| Command | Does |
|---|---|
| `backlog export` | Export the project's backlog as Backlog Markdown (kanban-md 1) to stdout or --out <file> |
| `backlog import <file>` | Import a markdown backlog (kanban-md standard or liberal `## Section` + `- [ ] item` styles) |

## board

Board-level diagnostics and context.

| Command | Does |
|---|---|
| `board risk-digest` | Get a risk digest of the current board state: merge blockers, stale sessions, low backlog, and health issues |
| `board context` | Get current project context: project info, issue counts by status, and active workspaces |

## butler

Interact with the project butler — a warm, persistent Claude assistant running in the project repo.

| Command | Does |
|---|---|
| `butler ask <question...>` | Ask the butler a question and print its answer |
| `butler ensure` | Start the butler's warm session if not already running |
| `butler stop` | Stop the butler's warm session and forget the resume id (next ensure starts fresh) |
| `butler interrupt` | Interrupt the butler's in-flight turn (session stays warm) |
| `butler model <name>` |  |
| `butler profile <name>` |  |
| `butler state` | Print the butler's current state (model, profile, context usage) |
| `butler list` | List the defined butlers and this project's warm state for each |

## butler skill

Read or write the project-scoped butler skill prompt.

| Command | Does |
|---|---|
| `butler skill get` | Print the butler's current prompt (project override if any, else the global default) |
| `butler skill set <prompt>` | Set the project-scoped butler prompt |

## drive

Inspect and manage autonomous-drive records.

| Command | Does |
|---|---|
| `drive start` | Start a new Drive: a first-class record of an autonomous epic push toward a target |
| `drive list` | List all Drives for a project (most recently started first) |
| `drive get <drive-id>` | Get a single Drive by ID, including its target, completion contract, status, and timestamps |
| `drive finish <drive-id>` | Finish a Drive: set terminal status (completed or abandoned) and stamp finishedAt |
| `drive review-effectiveness <drive-id>` | Per-drive AI code-review effectiveness: reviews run, reviews that bounced a ticket back, and merged-without-review |

## issue

Manage issues on the board.

| Command | Does |
|---|---|
| `issue list` | List issues for the active project |
| `issue get <issue-number>` | Show full details of an issue by its number |
| `issue create <title>` | Create a new issue in the active project |
| `issue update <issue>` | Update an existing issue's fields |
| `issue move <issue-id> <status>` | Move an issue to a different status |
| `issue status <issue-number>` | Quick status check for an issue: workspace state, session info, and last agent message |
| `issue summary <issue-number>` | Show a summary of the latest completed agent session for an issue |
| `issue create-sub <parent-number> <title>` | Create a child issue linked to a parent with a child_of dependency |
| `issue delete <issue-number>` | Delete an issue and all its associated data |
| `issue attach-artifact <issue-number>` | Attach a text, link, or image artifact to an issue |
| `issue create-batch <jsonFile>` | Create multiple issues atomically from a JSON file |
| `issue check-overlap <issueNumbers...>` | Check which files overlap between a set of issues based on their cached touched-file predictions |

## issue dependency

Manage issue dependencies.

| Command | Does |
|---|---|
| `issue dependency list <issue-id>` | List dependencies for an issue |
| `issue dependency add <issue-id> <target-id>` | Add a dependency between two issues |
| `issue dependency remove <dependency-id>` | Remove a dependency by its ID |
| `issue dependency analyze <issue-number>` | Analyze dependencies for an issue against the current board |
| `issue dependency update-batch <jsonFile>` | Add or remove multiple dependency edges atomically from a JSON file |

## openspec

Manage living OpenSpec domain specifications.

| Command | Does |
|---|---|
| `openspec list` | List the living OpenSpec domains for the active project |
| `openspec show <domain>` | Show a living OpenSpec domain spec |
| `openspec validate [change]` | Validate OpenSpec change deltas under openspec/changes |

## preferences

Manage CLI preferences.

| Command | Does |
|---|---|
| `preferences set <key> <value>` | Set a preference value |
| `preferences get <key>` | Get a preference value |

## services

Per-workspace Docker service-stack maintenance.

| Command | Does |
|---|---|
| `services reap` | Find (and with --yes, tear down) orphaned per-workspace Docker service stacks |

## session

Inspect agent sessions.

| Command | Does |
|---|---|
| `session analyze <session-id>` | Show a consolidated analysis of a session: workspace, issue, parsed summary with tool patterns, stats, and errors |
| `session recent` | List the most recent sessions across all workspaces with metadata |
| `session backfill-friction` | Populate friction stats (tool failures, repeated commands, errors) for past sessions from their stored messages, so /api/insights friction covers history |
| `session review-effectiveness` | Measure how the ticket-implementation workflow interacts with AI code review over a window |
| `session reviewer-fixes` | Measure how often the code-review agent FIXES findings itself (and commits) vs only approving |
| `session transcript <session-id>` | Retrieve a session transcript: metadata, workspace, issue, and ordered messages |
| `session search <query>` | Search agent session transcripts globally or within a project/issue |
| `session stats [session-id]` | Get token usage, cost, and duration stats for a session |
| `session friction` | Aggregate agent-session friction (failed tool calls, repeated commands, error counts) across all sessions in a recent time window |
| `session find-similar <issue-number>` | Search the failure-pattern memory for past incidents similar to a given error text or issue description |

## skill

Manage agent skills.

| Command | Does |
|---|---|
| `skill list` | List agent skills |
| `skill get <name-or-id>` | Show full details of a skill including its prompt template |
| `skill create <name>` | Create a new agent skill |
| `skill export <target-path>` | Export skills as SKILL.md files for Claude Code and Codex |
| `skill verify` | Check whether the bundled agent skills an agent actually reads are current |

## tag

Manage tags (labels) for categorizing issues.

| Command | Does |
|---|---|
| `tag list` | List all available tags |
| `tag create <name>` | Create a new tag |

## worker

Fleet worker: connect this machine to a board and execute assigned agent sessions.

| Command | Does |
|---|---|
| `worker pair` | Mint a short-lived, single-use pairing token on the board (run this WHERE THE BOARD RUNS; |
| `worker start` | Run the worker daemon: register with the board (first run needs --token from 'worker pair'), |
| `worker instructions` | Print a step-by-step runbook for connecting THIS machine to a remote board as a worker |
| `worker list` | List the board's registered workers with their effective status |

## workflow

Manage configurable workflow templates (graphs of stages + transitions).

| Command | Does |
|---|---|
| `workflow list` | List workflow templates for the active project (project-scoped + global built-ins) |
| `workflow get <templateId>` | Print a workflow template's full graph as JSON |
| `workflow export <templateId>` | Print a workflow template's importable JSON (metadata + nodes + edges) |
| `workflow create <jsonFile>` | Create a workflow template from a JSON file: { name, description?, ticketType?, isDefault?, nodes:[{id,name,nodeType,statusName?,skillName?,maxVisits?,config?}], edges:[{fromNodeId,toNodeId,label?,condition?}] } |
| `workflow import <jsonFile>` | Import a workflow template JSON file into the active project as a new template |
| `workflow delete <templateId>` | Delete a non-built-in workflow template |

## workspace

Manage workspaces (git worktrees linked to issues).

| Command | Does |
|---|---|
| `workspace list` | List workspaces for the active project |
| `workspace create <issue-id>` | Create a git worktree workspace for an issue |
| `workspace launch <workspace-id>` | Relaunch an idle workspace by starting a new agent session |
| `workspace resume <issue-number>` | Resume the latest workspace for an issue by launching a new agent session |
| `workspace wait <issue-number>` | Block until a workspace leaves its active state, then exit |
| `workspace review <workspace-id>` | Trigger an AI code review for an idle workspace |
| `workspace start <issue>` | One-step create + launch a workspace for an issue |
| `workspace diff <workspace-id>` | Get the git diff for a workspace |
| `workspace scorecard <workspace-id>` | Get the PR quality scorecard for a workspace |
| `workspace merge <workspace-id>` | Merge a workspace branch into the project's default branch |
| `workspace close <workspace-id>` | Close a workspace without merging |
| `workspace stop <workspace-id>` | Stop any running agent session for a workspace |
| `workspace delete <workspace-id>` | Delete a workspace and all its sessions, messages, and diff comments |
| `workspace relaunch <workspace-id>` | Relaunch an idle workspace by starting a new agent session |
| `workspace mark-ready <workspace-id>` | Mark a workspace as reviewed and ready to merge |
| `workspace propose-transition <workspace-id> <target-status>` | Advance a workspace's workflow to the next stage |
| `workspace clarify <workspace-id>` | Raise a clarifying question or propose the next workflow gate for a workspace |
| `workspace analyze-touched <issue-id>` | Predict which source files an issue will likely modify |
| `workspace terminal <workspace-id>` | Read agent session output (terminal messages) for a workspace |
| `workspace comment-list <workspace-id>` | List diff review comments for a workspace |
| `workspace comment-add <workspace-id>` | Add a review comment on a file in a workspace's diff |
| `workspace handoff-bundle <workspace-id>` | Export a compact handoff bundle for a workspace |
| `workspace approve-tool <workspace-id>` | Create a pending tool-use approval request for a workspace session |
